body.statement: Every symbolic formula returned by \(\operatorname{Branch\text{-}sCIDP}(\mathcal P;Y,X,C)\) equals \(\psi_{\mathbf M}(y;x,c)\) for every \(\mathbf M\in\mathfrak M_d^+(\mathcal P)\). The role graph has at most \(2^{|X\cup C|}\) states, every nonrepeating trace has length at most \(2^{|X\cup C|}-1\), and the shared formula DAG can be constructed in \(O(3^n\operatorname{poly}(n)+L_{\mathrm{form}})\) symbolic operations. No implication from \(\operatorname{AllFail}\) to nonidentification is asserted here.
body.justification: Exhaustive legal exchanges preserve the target and isolate the converse difficulty without sacrificing a usable positive identification procedure.
body.gap: Chen--Mooij prove soundness for their conditional procedure; the branch closure and shared-cache accounting are not stated as this explicit formula-search theorem.
body.consumer: PAGId can return selected-cohort formulas with a finite auditable role trace even before a complete failure theorem is available.
